title: ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. ciliata
intro: Ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. ciliata, commonly known as Chinese Ampelopsis or Porcelain Vine, is a type of flowering plant native to China, known for its unique, porcelain-like berries. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood lipid profiles, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ampelopsis brevipedunculata var. ciliata include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce blood pressure, and alleviate oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
